payload.core_mechanism_summary: For p % q != 0, output p. Else, factor q into primes. For each prime factor i with exponent e in q, reduce p by removing all i factors, then multiply by i^(e-1). Take max of these values.
payload.rationale: The solution uses direct mathematical computation (factorization and candidate construction) without any search, backtracking, or enumeration. It does not fit any complete_search subtype, but the mandatory candidate list forces a mismatch. Backtracking is the rule's top subtype but is inapplicable.
